def log_deprecated(name="", text="", eos=""):
    """
    Log deprecation warning.

    Args:
        name (str): name of the deprecated item.
        text (str, optional): information about the deprecation.
        eos (str, optional): end of service date such as "YYYY-MM-DD".
    """
    text = text if text else ""
    eos = eos if eos else ""

    if name:
        text = f"{name} " + text

    if eos:
        text = f"{text} is deprecated and will be removed on {eos}."
    else:
        text = f"{text} is deprecated."

    warnings.warn(text, DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
